meta.title: PartyWatcher — watch movies and videos together online
meta.description: PartyWatcher is a free watch-party service. Create a room, send the link to your friends and watch YouTube, Twitch and other videos in sync, with chat and voice.
meta.ogDescription: Create a room, send the link to your friends and watch videos in sync with chat and voice.

intro.title: Watch movies and videos together with friends
intro.text: PartyWatcher is an online watch-party service. Create a room, share the link, and everyone watches the same video in sync: YouTube, Twitch, Google Drive and other sources. Rooms have text chat and voice.

info.youtube_twitch:
Paste a YouTube video link (youtube.com/watch?v=... or youtu.be/...), a Twitch recording (VOD) link (twitch.tv/videos/1234567890 — a recording, not a live stream) or a VK Video link (vk.com/video-123_456, vkvideo.ru/video-123_456 or the embed code).
The service is detected automatically from the link.
A private VK video can only be embedded with its embed code ("Share" → "Export").
info.drive:
(not tested)
In Google Drive: right-click the video → "Share" → "Anyone with the link" → copy the link and paste it here. Otherwise the server cannot read the file.
info.player_capture:
Paste a link to a page where the video (a movie or series) already plays — that page’s player will be shown to everyone in the room in sync.
Not every site works: if no video is found, try another page.
⚠️ my.mail.ru is not supported.
Some sites let you pick the season/episode/player.
Whoever creates the room is responsible for its links and videos (see the terms).
info.direct:
Paste a READY direct video link — a regular site page address will NOT work here (e.g. a my.mail.ru watch page), only:
• a link to the video file itself: .mp4, .m3u8
• a link to an embed player that the site ITSELF allows to embed (not all sites allow it, e.g. my.mail.ru).
Such a link usually has to be found in the page source — the server does not look for it, unlike “Movie / series viewing”.
info.kodik:
Search an anime, drama or series by title and pick a voice-over — the video plays in the Kodik player right at each viewer (fast). The Kodik catalog has anime, dramas, Turkish, Indian and other Eastern movies and series; there are no Hollywood, European or Russian movies — use “Movie / series viewing” for those.
You can also paste a ready Kodik player link (kodikplayer.com/video/…).
The host switches season, episode and voice-over right in the player — viewers switch along.
